caption: Kar. 91. Altar
reading: wosi : sore(2)yi : ẖse(3)qorose qowyise i?o?ẖe(4)qowi : arpki?kli : te(5)d?ḫelowi : mksetẖ?l? te(6)rikelo(7)wi : ato(8)mẖe : pso?ẖe : kete : at(9)t?mẖe psḫrkete
notes: Text starts on this page (line 1 = wosi). 3-shaped signs (m/ẖ/s) chosen by tail form and context (mẖe in the formula). '113' groups read q+o (qo/qowi/qorose); could be s+y. Line 1 'qowyise': '4ⱡⱡ8' read w,y,i — the crossed strokes may also be ñ. Line 3 sign after 'arpk' is H-shaped, read i?. Line 5: one hatched sign after te with a trace, read d? (te[d]ḫelowi). Father's name 'mksetẖ?l?': last sign hatched. Line 9: two dotted t-like signs after a; second may be a misdrawn m. Benediction 1 'pso?ẖe : kete' — the '/3' could be q (pqẖe). Last group 'psḫrkete' has te with a dot.

caption: Kar. 92. Stela
reading: wo si : sore(2)yi : ld?tenke(3)lowi : arel?e(4)t?ke : sim?lote(5)lowi : tñyiñ : (6)wosktkil?deqo (7)wretḫnẖs(8)towi : atomẖe pso(9)ẖte atm?e : psẖep(10)siḫr : ḫẖ?lol? pso(11)ete :
notes: Gap between 'wo' and 'si' in line 1. Line 2 first group: small ϟ (l) then a <-shaped sign with long crossing tail, read d? (could be p). Line 4 group 'arel?e': an ∠-shaped sign read l?; t has a blob. 'sim?lote': H-shaped sign before the 3 read i; ')' read m. Crossed signs in 'tñyiñ' read ñ (could be d). Line 6-7 group ends in '113' read qo (could be sy). 'atm?e' has only one 3-shaped sign (ẖ omitted or 3 = mẖ). Second benediction second p is Σ-shaped (could be k). Final row 'ḫẖlol?' 3-shaped sign uncertain (ẖ/m/s).

caption: Kar. 93. Altar
reading: wo?[.]i? : a(2)reyi : (3)aktoye q?owi : (4)atomẖe : pso(5)ẖte : at mẖe : (6)p?ḫ(7)kete :
notes: First word heavily hatched: w clear, then hatched strokes (o?, a lost sign, i?). 'areyi' marked sic by Griffith (for asoreyi?). Line 3 group: '/11' read y; 'q?owi' with hatched 3. Sign with line 6 is ʒ-shaped with long tail: k or p; before ḫ, read p?. Small stroke before te in line 5 taken as te's bar.

caption: Kar. 94. Altar (Kar. Cem., Pl. 16, No. 7091)
labels: a, by line 1 (right of the first word)
reading: wi si : (2)soriyi : (3)tyliñ?liqowi : me(4)ẖyñ? : tedḫlowi : atke(5)lol? : terikelowi : t(6)ẖ?i : ẖsto(7)wi : ẖ(8)elke : ẖs(9)towi : qore(10)ñ?lowi : ato : mẖe : pso(11)ẖte : atmẖe : psiḫr : (12)ḫẖ?lol? q?ekte (13)wosi : as(14)ori(15)yi : tni?l?k(16)rl?o?wi : d?se(17)ke : ẖstowi (18)a(19)tomẖe p(20)siẖte : atmẖe (21)psi(22)ẖte :
notes: First word drawn '4ꝋ' (i joined to w) and '43': read 'wi si' as shown, likely for wosi. 'sori-' (twice): the sign before y is a 4 ligatured to r, read i (e expected). Crossed signs with a loop read ñ (lines 3, 4, 10); in tedḫlowi the crossed sign read d. tedḫlowi has one S between ḫ and o (read l; e omitted). Line 6 sign after t is 9-shaped, read ẖ?. Line 16 group: small '>' read l?, a flat dash read o?; uncertain. The 'p' in the benedictions is drawn '4ʒ' (ξ). '/3' in 'q?ekte' could be s+o. One text with continuous line numbers 1-22; labels a and b mark the two starts (wosi / wosi).

caption: Kar. 95. Altar
labels: sic, over the second se in line 3
vertical stroke after a at the start of line 2 (edge mark)
reading: a(2)soreyi : (3)dli sese?eqowi : ntki(4)li : tedḫli : tedḫlo(5)wi : sḫdteli : teri(6)kelowi : (7)[.] (8)[.]oẖte (9)atmlo : (10)psḫrkete : (11)ḫ?ẖlol : psẖo?l?ke(12)te :
notes: Text starts at asoreyi (no wosi). d is the ϱ form. Second se drawn J/// (sic). '4ʒ' in ntki read k+i (could be p). Line 7 is only a fragmentary mark (⊢ with a diagonal), line 8 blank space; then a faint trace before oẖte. 'atmlo': m is ρ-shaped. Line 11 first sign is c with a dot (ḫ or to). Last group: '/3' and a barred ϛ uncertain.

caption: Kar. 96. Altar with deities (Kar. Cem., Pl. 17, No. 7097)
reading: wosi : (2)soreyi : a(3)[.]ko?eliḫeqowi : n(4)tkili tedḫel? : tedḫeli yedḫe?li (5)tedḫelowi : s?we[.](6)li : terikel : (7)yerik(8)lowi : s?le(9)q?el : yetẖde(10)lowi : slo?ẖrto(11)wi : ḫẖ?lol : q?ekete : atomẖe : psi(12)ẖte : atmẖe : pesi(13)ḫrkete :
notes: Line 3 signs after a drawn in dotted outline (a slash), read [.] and o?. '<' read ḫ. A single dot (not a full divider) after ntkili, written as a space. Line 4 row: 'yedḫe?li' with a hatched sign read e?. Line 5 fragment (tedḫelowi) is written below line 4's left end and continues it. Hatching of about one sign before (6)li. 'yerik(8)lowi' and 'yetẖdelowi' begin with three strokes (y), not te. 'slo?ẖrtowi': a small comma-like stroke read o?.

caption: Kar. 97. Stela
labels: sic, over t after a at the end of line 11 (at for ato)
reading: wosi : asoreyi : (2)nkt?d?leqowi : (3)aḫeyñtko? : teri(4)kelowi : kd?iqowi e?[.](5)li : tedḫelowi : kmo?ry (6)yetẖd?tl? : yetẖdelo(7)wi : pesetoy?i : kror : (8)yetẖdelowi : ḫrped? (9)p?srsetel : yetẖde(10)lowi : meosrse : nlolo(11)te lowi at? : mẖe : pso?ẖi?(12)kete : atmẖe : psi : ḫ(13)rkete :
notes: Line 2 sign after t is ~-shaped (d? or n). Line 3 group: 3 with long tail at the end read k with a slash (o?); could be q. Crossed sign with a loop read ñ, without loop read d. Hatching of one sign in 'e?[.](5)li'. Line 6 group 'kmo?ry': thick ɯɯ read r. 'yetẖd?tl?': a hatched sign read d?. 'pesetoy?i': hatched strokes read y?. Line 9 first sign Σ/ʒ-shaped, read p?. 'at? : mẖe' (sic) for ato mẖe. 'pso?ẖi?kete': a small ㄴ-shaped sign read o?, a barred sign read i?.
